title: Canada-U.S. Tariff Talks Continue as Trump’s Midnight Deadline Looms
summary: Canadian negotiators were in Washington to finalize a deal that would stave off new tariffs and improve the terms of existing ones, but Mark Carney faces a tough sell back home.
